row_matching: line rows by normalized description; header and summary fields by labeled template cells
identity_policy: candidate-defined non-empty unique line IDs; IDs must join Line_Items to Provenance
header_policy: typed Excel dates and semantically equal readable dates are accepted; other header text is compared case-insensitively after whitespace normalization
discount_policy: the discount may be represented as a positive deduction or a negative signed amount when its magnitude, formula linkage, taxable amount, perturbation response, and final payable result are coherent
monetary_precision_policy: formula-linked currency values may retain exact intermediates or round to cents; the deterministic tolerance is one cent
provenance_policy: correct supplied filename and page plus a non-empty readable locator containing both; exact private locator strings are not required
